name: Vanocker Campground and RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 44.3865,-103.5121: open grass field with scattered RV pads behind the office on Pineview Dr at the south edge of Sturgis, pine forest to the south, a subdivision east; no water in frame; not waterfront

name: 3 Sons' RV Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 42.8742,-97.4385: dense RV loops north of the office plus a south loop whose inner row of pads sits on open lawn ~20-40 m from a ~150x80 m fishing pond, no tree screen between; operator markets the fishing pond; north loops are not on the water; pond

name: SPOT Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 44.3806,-97.5466: campground loops under continuous tree canopy east of a ~200 m pond on the east edge of De Smet; the pond's east shore is wooded and no pads are visible at the water; canopy can't confirm, defaults down; not waterfront

name: Schmidt's Landing
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 45.3785,-96.5603: two curved rows of RV pads in an open field 100-200 m back from the Big Stone Lake shore; the shoreline between is occupied by the store, suites, cabins and a band of trees; no pads at the water and no clear sightline; defaults down; not waterfront

name: Dakota Sioux Casino RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 45.0026,-97.1482: a row of angled pull-through pads south of the casino parking among farm fields; only a small field pothole ~300 m east; not waterfront
